extra.note: Per-tile member placement (columns/beams/grid) follows the same schema as F06.json's extra, offset by this tile's (tile_offset) and suffixed with '-T{index:05d}' on every tag/label -- not enumerated here to keep this truth file small.
extra.tile_offset_formula: (col * step_x, row * step_y), row-major, col = index % cols, row = index // cols
